title: 建築構法計画
subtitle: Building System Design
educationalGoal: In this course, students develop the knowledge required for planning, constructing, and maintaining buildings while comprehensively considering building materials, structural systems, and equipment. Specifically, they acquire the basic knowledge of building systems to standardize or componentize buildings, and learn new about designs in the environmental age.
advice:
This course explains the typical of structural systems and building elements from the viewpoints of required performance and construction work, and shows examples of superior building element design. In the first half of this course, structural systems are explained, outlining all the materials used and the points that need supervision in each type of construction work. In the latter half, finishing layers and substrates are explained with respect to each building element.
The contents of this course are as follows.
　1. Structural systems: steel construction, reinforced concrete construction, and wooden construction.
　2. Building elements: roofs, walls, openings, floors, stairs, and ceilings.
　3. Building system design methods: prefabrication, modular coordination, and componentization.
requiredKnowledge: Students don't need any special background, because this course is a first step in learning building production. Students are urged to deepen their understanding of structural systems and building elements by observing many buildings in their daily lives.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain the basics of building materials and building systems.
Students can explain the constituent elements and required performance of basic structural systems that support.
Students can explain the constituent elements and required performance of basic building elements that partition
Students can explain the merits of prefabrication, componentization, and industrialization of buildings.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can explain the basics of building materials and building systems, showing typical specifications. Based on their understanding of the constituent elements and required performance of basic structural systems as well as basic building elements, students can explain the important points that need supervision in construction work and in building maintenance. Based on their understanding of the merits of prefabrication, componentization, and industrialization of buildings, students are can explain important points for planning such structures.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can explain the basics of building materials and building systems. Based on their understanding of the constituent elements and required performance of basic structural systems as well as basic building elements, students can explain the important points that need supervision in construction works. Students can explain the merits of prefabrication, componentization, and industrialization of buildings.
